answers.core: Blank space after the end I think is pretty common in modern text editors and seems pretty easy to add. Seems like a very small but nice upgrade is all. A very low hanging fruit, if you will.
answers.workaround: This can be worked around by adding a bunch of new lines to the end of the file. However, this bloats the file line count and is a bit messy. Almost all my GDScript code on github has a bunch of extra new lines a the end if I forget to delete it after.

title: Blank space after end of code in text editor
